prompted_for: Black-on-white equipment drawing for the commissioning and qualification (svc-cq) service page, source for art/svc-cq.png and the Illustration component
composition: three objects grouped on an isometric plane
large closed ring binder dominant at back centre
clipboard checklist to its right, slightly lower
handheld meter with coiled cable and probe in the foreground left
layout_devices: coiled cable leading the eye from meter to probe
hang tag on the cable as a label carrier
typography: none; no text in the drawing
line_and_texture: parallel lines for binder pages and tab dividers
motion_implied: checklist boxes tick one by one
cable draws along its coil to the probe
t2i_keywords: black line art on white background
thick ring binder with tab dividers
t2i_prompt: Clean isometric line drawing, black lines on a pure white background, uniform stroke weight, no shading, no fill, no text, no people. A small still life of <CONTENT> arranged on one isometric plane: the largest object at the back, a flat document object to one side, and a handheld instrument with a coiled cable and probe in the foreground, a blank hang tag on the cable. Precise rounded corners, minimal interior detail, parallel lines for stacked pages, generous white margin on every side so the drawing can be traced into a single-colour mask.
signature_idea: Qualification shown as its tools: the binder, the checklist and the calibrated probe, drawn as one tidy isometric still life.
strengths: reads instantly as documentation plus measurement, the core of C&Q
single-weight clean lines trace well into a token-coloured mask
calm, uncluttered, plenty of white space
weaknesses: generic office objects; nothing says water or polypropylene
clipboard and binder are a stock C&Q cliché
meter and probe are slightly toy-like in proportion
brand_fit_why: Precise single-weight line work that recolours to navy or steel-blue and leaves space around it fits the brand; the subject is generic rather than Aquemi-specific.
